examples.chinese: 我平常早上七點起床，八點吃早飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng, bā diǎn chī zǎofàn.
examples.english: I usually get up at seven and have breakfast at eight in the morning.

examples.chinese: 我平常喜歡喝茶，有（的）時候喝一點兒咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng xǐhuān hē chá, yǒu (de) shíhou hē yìdiǎnr kāfēi.
examples.english: I usually like drinking tea. Sometimes I drink a little coffee.

examples.chinese: 我平常喜歡喝茶，有(的)時候喝一點兒咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng xǐhuān hē chá, yǒu(de) shíhou hē yìdiǎnr kāfēi.
examples.english: I usually like to drink tea; sometimes I drink a little coffee.

examples.chinese: 我平常坐紅線去學校上課，週末也坐捷運去運動、看電影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zuò hóng xiàn qù xuéxiào shàngkè, zhōumò yě zuò jiéyùn qù yùndòng, kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: I usually go to school by the red one. On weekends I take it to exercise or see a movie as well.

examples.chinese: 平常不生病的人也要注意。
examples.pinyin: Píngcháng bù shēngbìng de rén yě yào zhùyì.
examples.english: People who don’t get sick often should pay attention to their health as well.

items.wordHook: 平(flat) + 常(common) → flat and common days: 平常(generally; usually).

examples.chinese: A:你要不要去樓下的客廳看電視？ B:謝謝，我想先去樓上的房間休息。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ yào bù yào qù lóuxià de kètīng kàn diànshì? B: Xièxie, wǒ xiǎng xiān qù lóushàng de fángjiān xiūxi.
examples.english: A: Do you want to go to the living room downstairs to watch TV? B: Thanks, I want to go to the room upstairs to rest first.

examples.chinese: 鞋子都在一樓，我們到樓下去吧！九點了，百貨公司快要關了。
examples.pinyin: Xiézi dōu zài yì lóu, wǒmen dào lóuxià qù ba! Jiǔ diǎn le, bǎihuògōngsī kuàiyào guān le.
examples.english: All the shoes are on the first floor. Let’s go downstairs. It’s 9:00; the department store is closing soon.

examples.chinese: 我以為張先生是那家公司的大老闆，其實他只是個小職員。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi Zhāng xiānsheng shì nà jiā gōngsī de dà lǎobǎn, qíshí tā zhǐshì gè xiǎo zhíyuán.
examples.english: I thought Mr. Zhang was the big boss of that company, but actually he is just a small clerk.

examples.chinese: 那家貿易公司跟美國做生意，職員都得會說英文。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā màoyì gōngsī gēn Měiguó zuò shēngyì, zhíyuán dōu děi huì shuō Yīngwén.
examples.english: That trade company does business with America, so the employees all have to be able to speak English.

examples.chinese: 在那家公司上班的職員，都要穿襯衫、長褲。
examples.pinyin: Zài nà jiā gōngsī shàngbān de zhíyuán, dōu yào chuān chènshān, chángkù.
examples.english: Employees who work at that company all have to wear shirts and long pants.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，面試時要準備的相關文件包括個人基本資料、畢業證書等等。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, miànshì shí yào zhǔnbèi de xiāngguān wénjiàn bāokuò gèrén jīběn zīliào, bìyè zhèngshū děngděng.
examples.english: Generally speaking, the relevant documents to prepare for an interview include basic personal information, graduation certificate, and so on.

examples.chinese: 這份文件很急，請你下班以前傳真給對方公司。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn wénjiàn hěn jí, qǐng nǐ xiàbān yǐqián chuánzhēn gěi duìfāng gōngsī.
examples.english: This document is very urgent; please fax it to the other company before you get off work.

examples.chinese: 印章也叫圖章，華人常在重要的文件上使用印章。
examples.pinyin: Yìnzhāng yě jiào túzhāng, Huárén cháng zài zhòngyào de wénjiàn shàng shǐyòng yìnzhāng.
examples.english: A seal is also called a stamp; Chinese people often use seals on important documents.

examples.chinese: 你來得正好，請你幫我檢查這些文件，我一個人實在做不來。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ lái de zhènghǎo, qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ jiǎnchá zhèxiē wénjiàn, wǒ yí ge rén shízài zuò bù lái.
examples.english: You've come at just the right time; please help me check these documents—I really can't do it alone.

items.wordHook: Combining 文(culture) and 件(item): 文件 means document.

items.key: ["B3L16-2-25","无论如何","無論如何","无论如何","Conj"]

examples.chinese: 照顧還沒成年的孩子是父母應盡的責任，無論如何，既然生了就該養他、教導他。
examples.pinyin: Zhàogù hái méi chéngnián de háizi shì fùmǔ yīng jìn de zérèn, wúlùnrúhé, jìrán shēng le jiù gāi yǎng tā, jiàodǎo tā.
examples.english: Taking care of children who are not yet adults is a responsibility parents should fulfill; in any case, since you gave birth to them, you should raise them and educate them.

examples.chinese: 那位母親寧可犧牲自己的生命，也要保護孩子的安全。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi mǔqīn nìngkě xīshēng zìjǐ de shēngmìng, yě yào bǎohù háizi de ānquán.
examples.english: That mother would rather sacrifice her own life to protect her child's safety.

examples.chinese: 如果不與別人競爭，你就無法進步。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ bù yǔ biérén jìngzhēng, nǐ jiù wúfǎ jìnbù.
examples.english: If you don't compete with others, you won't be able to make progress.
